newsitem.title: GERMANY: No date set yet for Messer Griesheim float.
newsitem.headline: No date set yet for Messer Griesheim float.

text.p: Herbert Rudolf, head of the chemicals group Messer Griesheim GmbH, said on Wednesday that although it had been agreed in principle that the Hoechst AG unit would be floated, no date was set for the listing yet.
However he said that various formalities which had to be dealt with before the listing could take place meant that it was unlikely to be completed before the end of the year.

Rudolf told a news conference in Frankfurt that he hoped to get approval for the plan this year, adding that formal agreement had been delayed due to the illness of a member of the Messer family which controls the group.
The company also had to be converted to a joint stock company (AG) before a listing could be carried out.
